arxiv-2012-10564.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Abhishek K Dubey 1 , Michael T Young 1 , Christopher Stanley 1 , Dalton Lunga 1 , and Jacob Hinkle 1 1 Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, TN, USA { dubeyak, youngmt1, stanleycb, lungadd, hinklejd } @ornl.gov. Deep learning (DL) models are being deployed at medical centers to aid radiologists for diagnosis of lung conditions from chest radiographs. Such models are often trained on a large volume of publicly available labeled radiographs.

arxiv-2012-11228.title: Alternating linear scheme in a Bayesian framework for low-rank tensor approximation
arxiv-2012-11228.creator: Clara Menzen, Manon Kok, Kim Batselier)
arxiv-2012-11228.description: Abstract Multiway data often naturally occurs in a tensorial format which can be approximately represented by a low-rank tensor decomposition. This is useful because complexity can be significantly reduced and the treatment of large-scale data sets can be facilitated. In this paper, we find a low-rank representation for a given tensor by solving a Bayesian inference problem.

arxiv-2203-08503.title: Exact tricritical point from next-to-leading-order stability analysis
arxiv-2203-08503.creator: Michael Thies
arxiv-2203-08503.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michael Thies. In the massive chiral Gross-Neveu model, a phase boundary separates a homogeneous from an inhomogeneous phase. It consists of two parts, a second order line and a first order line, joined at a tricritical point. Whereas the first order phase boundary requires a full, numerical Hartree-Fock calculation, the second order phase boundary can be determined exactly and with less effort by a perturbative stability analysis. We extend this stability analysis to higher order perturbation theory.

arxiv-2205-04026.title: I Know What You Draw: Learning Grasp Detection Conditioned on a Few Freehand Sketches
arxiv-2205-04026.creator: Haitao Lin, Chilam Cheang, Yanwei Fu, Xiangyang Xue
arxiv-2205-04026.description: Abstract In this paper, we are interested in the problem of generating target grasps by understanding freehand sketches. The sketch is useful for the persons who cannot formulate language and the cases where a textual description is not available on the fly. However, very few works are aware of the usability of this novel interactive way between humans and robots.

arxiv-2308-15895.title: Assessing Drivers’ Situation Awareness in Semi-Autonomous Vehicles ASP based Characterisations of Driving Dynamics for Modelling Scene Interpretation and Projection
arxiv-2308-15895.creator: Jakob Suchan Jan-Patrick Osterloh
arxiv-2308-15895.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jakob Suchan Jan-Patrick Osterloh. Semi-autonomous driving, as it is already available today and will eventually become even more accessible, implies the need for driver and automation system to reliably work together in order to ensure safe driving. A particular challenge in this endeavour are situations in which the vehicle’s automation is no longer able to drive and is thus requesting the human to take over.

arxiv-2311-12759.title: Thermodynamic Matrix Exponentials and Thermodynamic Parallelism
arxiv-2311-12759.creator: Samuel Duffield ∗, Maxwell Aifer ∗, Gavin Crooks, Thomas Ahle, Patrick J. Coles
arxiv-2311-12759.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Samuel Duffield ∗, Maxwell Aifer ∗, Gavin Crooks, Thomas Ahle, Patrick J. Coles. Thermodynamic computing exploits fluctuations and dissipation in physical systems to efficiently solve various mathematical problems. It was recently shown that certain linear algebra problems can be solved thermodynamically, leading to a speedup scaling with the matrix dimension. The origin of this “thermodynamic advantage” has not yet been fully explained, and it is not clear what other problems might benefit from it.

arxiv-2312-03471.title: Gamma-ray spectra of the Crab, Vela and Geminga pulsars fitted with SED of the emission from their current sheet
arxiv-2312-03471.creator: Houshang Ardavan
arxiv-2312-03471.description: Abstract We show that the spectral energy distribution (SED) of the tightly focused radiation generated by the superluminally moving current sheet in the magnetosphere of a non-aligned neutron star fits the gamma-ray spectra of the Crab, Vela and Geminga pulsars over the entire range of photon energies so far detected by Fermi-LAT, MAGIC and HESS from them: over 10 2

arxiv-2404-01758.title: GEARS: Local Geometry-aware Hand-object Interaction Synthesis
arxiv-2404-01758.creator: Keyang Zhou, Bharat Lal Bhatnagar, Jan Eric Lenssen, Gerard Pons-Moll
arxiv-2404-01758.description: Abstract Generating realistic hand motion sequences in interaction with objects has gained increasing attention with the growing interest in digital humans. Prior work has illustrated the effectiveness of employing occupancy-based or distance-based virtual sensors to extract hand-object interaction features. Nonetheless, these methods show limited generalizability across object categories, shapes and sizes.

arxiv-2405-20750.title: Diffusion Models Are Innate One-Step Generators
arxiv-2405-20750.creator: Bowen Zheng, Tianming Yang
arxiv-2405-20750.description: Abstract Diffusion Models (DMs) have achieved great success in image generation and other fields. By fine sampling through the trajectory defined by the SDE/ODE solver based on a well-trained score model, DMs can generate remarkable high-quality results. However, this precise sampling often requires multiple steps and is computationally demanding.

arxiv-2409-04293.title: Time-dependent dynamics in the confined lattice Lorentz gas
arxiv-2409-04293.creator: Alessio Squarcini, Antonio Tinti, Pierre Illien, Olivier Bénichou, Thomas Franosch
arxiv-2409-04293.description: Abstract We study a lattice model describing the non-equilibrium dynamics emerging from the pulling of a tracer particle through a disordered medium occupied by randomly placed obstacles. The model is considered in a restricted geometry pertinent for the investigation of confinement-induced effects.

arxiv-2409-14780.title: Using dust to constrain dark matter models
arxiv-2409-14780.creator: Adam J. Ussing, Robert Adriel Mostoghiu Paun, Darren Croton, Celine Boehm, Alan Duffy, Chris Power
arxiv-2409-14780.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Adam J. Ussing, Robert Adriel Mostoghiu Paun, Darren Croton, Celine Boehm, Alan Duffy, Chris Power. In this paper, we use hydrodynamic zoom-in simulations of Milky Way-type haloes to explore using dust as an observational tracer to discriminate between cold and warm dark matter (WDM) universes.

arxiv-2504-16643.title: Multiple Rota-Baxter algebra and multiple Rota-Baxter modules
arxiv-2504-16643.creator: Jun He, Xiao-song Peng, Yi Zhang
arxiv-2504-16643.description: Abstract . In this paper, we develop the theory of multiple Rota-Baxter modules over multiple Rota-Baxter algebras. We introduce left, right, and bimodule structures and construct free Ω \Omega -operated modules with mixable tensor establishing free commutative multiple Rota-Baxter modules. We provide a necessary and sufficient condition for a free module to admit a free multiple Rota-Baxter module structure.

arxiv-2505-07734.title: LAMM-ViT: AI Face Detection via Layer-Aware Modulation of Region-Guided Attention
arxiv-2505-07734.creator: Jiangling Zhang, Weijie Zhu, Jirui Huang, Yaxiong Chen
arxiv-2505-07734.description: Abstract Detecting AI-synthetic faces presents a critical challenge: it is hard to capture consistent structural relationships between facial regions across diverse generation techniques. Current methods, which focus on specific artifacts rather than fundamental inconsistencies, often fail when confronted with novel generative models.

arxiv-2506-23991.title: Poisson-Dirac Submanifolds as a Paradigm for Imposing Constraints in Non-dissipative Plasma Models
arxiv-2506-23991.creator: F.W.Pinto, J.W.Burby
arxiv-2506-23991.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by F.W.Pinto, J.W.Burby. We present a generalisation of Dirac constraint theory based on the theory of Poisson-Dirac Submanifolds. The theory is formulated in a coordinate free manner while simultaneously relaxing the invertibility condition as seen in standard Dirac constraint theory. We illustrate the method with two examples: elimination of the electron number density using Gauss’ Law and Ideal MHD as a slow manifold constraint in the ideal two-fluid model.

arxiv-2512-19975.title: An Explicit dg–Lie Model Governing Jordan Algebra Deformations
arxiv-2512-19975.creator: Vincent E. Coll, Jr
arxiv-2512-19975.description: Abstract Over a field of characteristic 0 0 we place the deformation theory of Jordan algebras on a concrete, computation–friendly differential graded Lie algebra. On the symmetric cochains C n ​ ( J ) = Sym n ​ ( J ∨ ) ⊗ J C^{n}(J)=\mathrm{Sym}^{n}(J^{\vee})\otimes J we define an unshuffle–averaged insertion whose commutator is a graded Lie bracket.

pmc-10610541.title: Formulation and Characterization of Curcumin Niosomes: Antioxidant and Cytotoxicity Studies
pmc-10610541.creator: Shazia Akram Ghumman, Amna Ijaz, Sobia Noreen, Afeefa Aslam, Rizwana Kausar, Ali Irfan, Sumera Latif, Gamal A. Shazly, Pervaiz Akhtar Shah, Maria Rana, Asma Aslam, Momina Altaf, Katarzyna Kotwica-Mojzych, Yousef A. Bin Jardan
pmc-10610541.description: Curcumin’s applications in the treatment of conditions including osteoarthritis, dementia, malignancies of the pancreas, and malignancies of the intestines have drawn increasing attention. It has several wonderful qualities, including being an anti-inflammatory agent, an anti-mutagenic agent, and an antioxidant, and has substantially reduced inherent cytotoxicity outcomes.

pmc-11307301.title: Photocatalytic Hydrogen Peroxide Production by a Mixed Ligand-Functionalized Uranyl–Organic Framework
pmc-11307301.creator: Xuemin Wang, Jinlu Li, Xiaoyu Wei, Jianxin Song, Jian Xie, Zhenyu Li, Mengnan Yuan, Lisha Jiang, Yanlong Wang, Chao Liang, Wei Liu
pmc-11307301.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) production driven by solar energy has received enormous attention due to its high efficiency, low cost, and environmental friendliness characteristics. Searching for new photocatalytic materials for H2O2 production is one of the most important targets. In this work, a new three-dimensional (3D) uranyl–organic framework material was constructed with mixed ligands via a solvothermal reaction and used for photocatalytic H2O2 production.

pmc-11403902.title: Exploring Cesarean Section Delivery Patterns in South India: A Bayesian Multilevel and Geospatial analysis of Population-Based Cross-Sectional Data
pmc-11403902.creator: Mayank Singh, Anuj Singh, Jagriti Gupta
pmc-11403902.description: BackgroundThis paper focuses on the period from 2019 to 2021 and investigates the factors associated with the high prevalence of C-section deliveries in South India. We also examine the nuanced patterns, socio-demographic associations, and spatial dynamics underlying C-section choices in this region. A cross-sectional study was conducted using large nationally representative survey data.

pmc-11691231.title: RELATIONAL RELIGIOSITY, FORGIVENESS, AND FAMILY FUNCTIONING IN OLDER AFRICAN AMERICAN COUPLES
pmc-11691231.creator: Antonius Skipper, Andrew Rose, Seungjong Cho
pmc-11691231.description: Despite recent advances in studies on positive psychology, relatively little is known about the factors that influence the romantic relationships of older African Americans. Existing literature does note that older African Americans are among the most religious racial/ethnic groups in the United States.

pmc-11712480.title: Understanding cognitive deficits in memory clinic patients with mixed disease by combining plasma markers and advanced diffusion MRI
pmc-11712480.creator: Anna Dewenter, Amir Dehsarvi, Anna Steward, Davina Biel, Julia Pescoller, Zeyu Zhu, Fabian Wagner, Mattes Gross, Brigitte Nuscher, Sebastian Niclas Roemer, Katharina Buerger, Daniel Janowitz, Michael Ewers, Steffen Tiedt, Martin Dichgans, Matthias Brendel, Nicolai Franzmeier
pmc-11712480.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMemory clinic patients typically present with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) to varying degrees. Therefore, it is crucial to determine the etiology of cognitive deficits for facilitating patient‐centered treatment in memory clinics. Plasma biomarkers (ptau217, Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein [GFAP], Neurofilament light chain [NfL]) and fixel‐based advanced diffusion MRI markers (fiber density, fiber‐bundle cross‐section) show potential towards disentangling AD‐ and SVD‐related brain changes (Dewenter et al., Brain, 2023).

pmc-12410664.title: Complications after complex device implantation: how important is implanter seniority?
pmc-12410664.creator: Paul A Scott, Antonio Cannata, Daniel I Bromage, Ian J Wright, Anish Bhuva, Matthew J Lovell, Chris Plummer, Mark de Belder, Mark Dayer, Francis Murgatroyd
pmc-12410664.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe complication risk of procedures may be influenced by operator and institutional characteristics. Our aim was to assess whether supervising consultant seniority and operative volume, and hospital volume were associated with the risk of reintervention following complex device implantation.MethodsA nationwide population-based study was performed using the National Institute for Cardiovascular Outcomes Research registry including all patients receiving their first transvenous implantable cardioverter defibrillator or cardiac resynchronisation therapy (CRT) implant in England over 5 years (April 2014–March 2019).

pmc-12413328.title: Toward a performative epistemology of the archive: archival enactment as Rum futurity
pmc-12413328.creator: Christina Banalopoulou
pmc-12413328.description: This article maps the alternative archives of the Rum community, those that do not fully align either with national mnemonics or the minority’s dominant archival politics. I demonstrate how the Rum minority performs and enacts its archives—what I define as archival enactment—in order to claim grassroots agency in its mnemonic preservation.

pmc-12598278.title: How Cardiac Output May be Described in Fontan Patients: An Approximative Equation
pmc-12598278.creator: Manfred Marx, Sulaima Albinni, Erwin Kitzmüller, Ina Michel-Behnke

pmc-12821808.title: Nomogram based on MRI features and clinical indicators for predicting the risk of limited mouth opening in patients with temporomandibular disorders
pmc-12821808.creator: Chuanfang Xu, Xianyan Wu, Shibin Li, Qun Zhong, Jiena Pan, Chengbin Ye, Wenjie Yan
pmc-12821808.description: BackgroundLimited mouth opening (LMO) is a cardinal manifestation of temporomandibular disorders (TMD). The prognostic value of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features for predicting LMO remains insufficiently defined. We aimed to systematically analyse MRI characteristics alongside clinical indicators in patients with TMD, identify independent predictors of LMO, and develop and validate an interpretable, clinically actionable nomogram.

pmc-13207313.title: Coordinated Cell-Wall and Starch Maturation Is Associated with Winter-Harvest Quality in Sparganium stoloniferum Tubers
pmc-13207313.creator: Xilong Qian, Maoqi Pan, Jingying Zhang, Qinan Liu, Fan Yang, Chanchan Liu, Mengru Sang, Qinan Wu
pmc-13207313.description: Sparganium stoloniferum tubers (SL), known medicinally as Sparganii Rhizoma, are commonly considered superior at the winter-harvest stage, when they show the traditional quality traits of heavy weight and firm texture. However, the developmental basis of this quality phenotype remains insufficiently understood.

pmc-13229447.title: Diagnostic Challenge of Small Bowel Neuroendocrine Tumour Mimicking Biliary Disease: A Case Report
pmc-13229447.creator: Bisma Nazir, Ariba Mumtaz, Salman Zafar, Nimra Sadiq, Yasir Ihsan
pmc-13229447.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Small bowel neuroendocrine tumours (NETs) are uncommon neoplasia that often occur with non-specific gastrointestinal symptoms, leading to considerable delays in diagnosis and treatment, and overlapping findings that often distract the clinical focus from the underlying pathology. We present the case of a 49-year-old woman who reported to us with a one-month history of epigastric pain, nausea, vomiting, and unintentional weight loss of about two stones.

pmc-13247883.title: Quantitative magnetic resonance imaging during knee hyperextension for the evaluation of screw-home mechanism abnormalities in patients with anterior cruciate ligament injury: a clinical study
pmc-13247883.creator: Zhenying Li, Wenjie Chen, Jingmu Chen, Xiaoliang Tan, Shaoteng Li
pmc-13247883.description: BackgroundAnterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury, a common sports-related knee ligament injury, often leads to screw-home mechanism (SHM) dysfunction and joint instability. Clinical testing and conventional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) do not provide satisfactory quantitative assessment of functional instability post-acute ACL injury.

pmc-13434591.title: Venous thromboembolism prophylaxis in pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease: evidence gaps and future directions from the KASID Guidelines Task Force Team
pmc-13434591.creator: Jiyoung Yoon, Eun Mi Song, Dong Hyun Kim, Young Joo Yang, Seung Yong Shin, Ji Eun Kim, June Hwa Bae, Seung Min Hong, Sang-Bum Kang, Eun Soo Kim, Seong-Eun Kim, Seong-Jung Kim, Jun Lee, Soo-Young Na, Soo Jung Park, Sang Hyoung Park, Myung Ha Kim, Won Moon, Sung-Ae Jung, KASID Guidelines Taskforce Tea
pmc-13434591.description: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a serious and potentially life-threatening complication in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with the risk further increased during pregnancy and the postpartum period. Pregnancy induces a physiological hypercoagulable state, which, when combined with the chronic inflammatory and prothrombotic milieu of IBD, may result in synergistic thrombotic risk.

pmc-5897557.title: Progress and challenges towards targeted delivery of cancer therapeutics
pmc-5897557.creator: Rosenblum D, Joshi N, Tao W et al.
pmc-5897557.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). Targeted delivery approaches for cancer therapeutics have shown a steep rise over the past few decades.
